title: Unity Just Ran a Game Inside Unreal Engine
deck: A real-time bridge could let Unity developers reach Fortnite without rebuilding their games in UEFN.

leadImage.alt: Unity and Unreal Engine running the same game side by side

body:
For most of game development history, moving a project between Unity and Unreal Engine meant rebuilding major parts of the game. A new real-time bridge points toward a different future.

### What changes

Unity can remain responsible for game logic and simulation while Unreal renders the player-facing experience.
